transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too. Well, I'm here because... people just keep telling me I'm not listening. 

My supervisor at the plant, or my wife, they'll be talking straight to me, and a minute later I realize I only caught about half of what they said. Then I'm stuck asking them to say it all over again. It's causing a lot of frustration, so I figured I needed to come in and see what's going on.
Do you think your hearing is worse than it used to be?
No, my hearing is fine. I passed the hearing test at work not too long ago. It's not that I can't hear them talking, it's just... the words don't always stick.
Did you have this same kind of trouble paying attention when you were a child?

Yeah, I was like this even as a kid. I remember teachers were always moving my seat around because I just couldn't stay put. I'd call out answers in class, and... well, I got into trouble a lot for butting into other kids' work. That was all happening way back before middle school, even.
Besides work, does this same problem happen at home too?

Yeah, it definitely happens at home. My wife and kids... they get pretty frustrated with me. Instead of helping keep things running smoothly around the house, I just end up disrupting whatever routine we have going. 

And honestly, it's getting really bad at the plant, too. It’s serious enough now that I’ve actually had formal warnings. I'm really worried I could lose my job over this, or... or even cause a safety problem on the line. That's really why I had to come in.
Do you often feel so worried or anxious that it makes it hard to focus on what people are saying?

No, I wouldn't say I'm an anxious person. I mean, sure, I'm worried about my job right now, but that's not what's causing the problem. It's not like I'm sitting there panicking and that's why I can't listen. It's just... I just can't seem to stay tuned in, no matter how calm I am.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety, like it’s hard to stay seated?

Yeah, all the time. If I'm sitting in a safety huddle at the plant or just at the dinner table at home, my leg is always bouncing. My hands are always messing with something, like a pen or my keys. People even tell me I'm shaking the whole bench sometimes. It's just really hard to sit still.
